explanation: The value is 0 everywhere except at D2 after the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by a common transition; choosing a1, or any rare transition, gives 0. In those a2-to-S2 cases it is about 9-10 when the agent has been choosing a2 steadily and getting rewarded, especially late in the episode (trial 80 or later), around 5-8 earlier in the episode, and only 1-4 right after switching to a2 or after a run of unrewarded trials.
